desc: Vibrant contemporary brasserie serving modern interpretations of Indian food with juices.
addr: First & Second Floor, 2989/B, 2989/B, 12th Main Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: I saw lot of reviews on google and wanted to try this place very badly, and i must saw i am so much in love with their dishes. …

Bombay Brassiere located at Indiranagar, Bengaluru is part of the famous and popular chain of restaurants in India. They are well known for their variety of North Indian cuisine. We went there as a family reunion and enjoyed our evening. We …

We came for a mid week dinner and between the two of us, we shared the Bombay bhel (great texture and flavour), pepper wings (spicy but good), Irani kheema maska pao (tasty), prawn curry with coconut rice (the curry was good but the coconut rice was let down by an excess of coconut milk/cream - it was far too wet).
